svg.title: How Q-NEXUS is built
svg.desc: People: Ten roles, Vendors. App: React app, Fastify API, Shared rules. Services: Offer reader, Read-only MCP, Vendor email. Data & AI: PostgreSQL, Document store, AI gateway. One company VPS behind Nginx, daily database backups, releases from GitHub Actions after checks pass.
